description: This file defines the UserController class within the Conduit.Features.Users namespace. The controller handles HTTP requests related to user data, including retrieving current user details and updating user information, utilizing MediatR for command/query handling, and enforcing authorization with JWT schemes.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller handling user-related HTTP endpoints, allowing retrieval and update of user details.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current user's details.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the current user's information.
